newsitem.title: USA: CSX, Conrail to reaffirm merger deal - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: CSX, Conrail to reaffirm merger deal - WSJ.

text.p: CSX Corp and Conrail Inc are expected to reaffirm their $8.5 billion merger deal after failing to agree on an improved CSX offer for the railroad company, the Wall Street Journal reported on Wednesday.
The newspaper cited "people familiar with the situation" as saying Conrail's board of directors was set to reject Norfolk Southern Corp's $10 billion cash bid for it.
Conrail and CSX have been trying to ward off a rival bid by Norfolk for weeks. Some investors have criticized their efforts, saying Norfolk's offer was better.
Conrail's stock ended higher at 97-5/8 on the New York Stock Exchange on Tuesday amid expectations that the railroad would revise the terms of its deal with CSX.
The newspaper said Conrail's board was expected to tell the railroad's shareholders to tender their shares to CSX in its outstanding tender offer for 20 percent of the stock.
Both companies are also to issue a statement saying they are discussing ways to increase the value offered to Conrail shareholders, it said.
